n0.statement: Will the United States win the men's ice hockey gold medal at the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics?
n0.report: Child n2 (winning the gold-medal game) is the same proposition as the parent and therefore receives full weight. Child n1 (advancing to the gold-medal game) is necessary but not sufficient for winning and adds no independent information beyond n2, so it receives zero weight. This yields p_parent = p_n2 = 0.40.
